allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of shares pursuant to Rights Issue.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: In relation of the rights issue of the company, we hereby inform you that the Board at its meeting held today i.e. on November 19, 2026 has considered and approved the extension of the closing date of the Rights issue till November 23, 2026

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer, Entitlement Letter along with the Application Form for Rights Issue.'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 8, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 8 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 1.50 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Approval of Rights Issue for an amount not exceeding Rs. 1200 lakhs.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 30, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation Of Grant Of 18,00,000 Stock Options Under Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited Employees Stock Option Plan 2021 ('SIL-ESOP 2021') And Grant Of 18,00,000 Stock Options Under Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited Employees Stock Option Plan 2018 ('SIL-ESOP 2018')'.
